evidence.quote: Dealt. You hold the 10 and 6 for 16, with 100 staked.
You can't stick on 14. Pontoon rules say you need 15 or better

criteria.why: Replies are short, plain dealer talk with no JSON, ids, or tool talk. 'Pontoon rules say' is game vocabulary, not system rules.

evidence.quote: Bought the 3 of hearts. You're on 19 with 200 staked.
You can't stick on 14. ... so you have to twist or buy.

criteria.why: Every bet, twist, buy and stick is acted on, and the impossible stick on 14 is refused plainly with the legal options named.

evidence.quote: The dealer turns over the king and 5 for 15, then twists on 16 or less and draws the 4 of clubs for 19.
The dealer sticks on 17 or more, and your 19 beats 18.

criteria.why: The dealer plays out and settles in the same turn as the stick, and the croupier never picks a move or bet for the player.

evidence.quote: You win 200 at even money, and your bankroll is now 1,300.

criteria.why: Totals, results and bankroll in each reply match the surface data and the earlier replies, e.g. 1,100 then 1,300 across rounds.
